title: DeFiDataDex
tagline: DeFiDataDex is a decentralized marketplace for retail DeFi traders to upload, buy, and curate high-quality datasets. Earn Filecoin tokens for contributing and curating data. Ensuring transparency and data integrity through decentralized storage.
description: DeFiDataDex is a decentralized marketplace designed to facilitate the exchange of high-quality datasets for retail DeFi traders. By leveraging the Filecoin blockchain, DeFiDataDex incentivizes users to upload, purchase, and curate valuable DeFi datasets, ensuring data integrity and transparency. This project aims to unify the fragmented DeFi data landscape, providing a reliable platform for both traders and data curators.
how_its_made: DeFiDataDex is built using a combination of advanced technologies to create an efficient decentralized marketplace for DeFi datasets. We leverage Lighthouse for reliable file storage and retrieval on the Filecoin network, ensuring data permanence. The frontend, developed with Next.js and Shadcn UI, provides a sleek, user-friendly interface. Our Flask-based API offers sophisticated data analysis and AI-powered insights. Some datasets are sourced using The Graph for efficient blockchain data querying. Additionally, WalletConnect (Web3Connect) facilitates secure wallet interactions, enabling smooth transactions. These integrated technologies ensure a seamless, high-quality experience for users engaging in the DeFi dataset marketplace.
